comment: Cross-runtime fixtures. vitest runs these against the TypeScript source; ExcerptTests runs them against the compiled bundle inside JavaScriptCore. One file, two runtimes — the only way 'one engine' is a fact rather than an intention.

cases.name: a settled decision is a decision
lines: Okay. Let's move the campaign launch to October. That's decided.

cases.name: a proposal is recorded as proposed, never as decided
lines: What if we moved the launch to October?

cases.name: first person on your own microphone is assigned to you
lines: I'll take the revised deck and get it over by Thursday.

cases.name: a request from the far side is never assigned to you
lines: Can you send the revised deck before Friday?

cases.name: someone else committing themselves is not your action
a decision not to do something is still a decision
lines: We're not moving the launch to October.

cases.name: a negation that narrows a plan is not a decision against it
lines: We're not moving the whole campaign, just the hero spot.

cases.name: a conditional never reaches decided
lines: If media come back early we could move the launch to October.

cases.name: discussing a future discussion decides nothing
lines: We'll discuss October next week once media come back.

cases.name: reported speech is not our decision
lines: She said they decided to move the launch to October.

cases.name: an unanswered question stays open
lines: Do we still need the out-of-home buy?
I'm not sure the out-of-home spend is justified yet.

cases.name: an answered question is not an open question
lines: Do we still need the out-of-home buy?
Yes, media confirmed it this morning.

cases.name: a vague commitment is not an action
lines: I'll have a look at some point.

cases.name: unrelated speech yields nothing at all
lines: Did you see the game last night?
Only the second half. The weather here has been terrible.
Same. I pulled the last four weeks this morning.

cases.name: titles are verbatim spans, never rewritten
lines: Right, so let's lock the October date. That's decided.

expect.titleIsSpanOf: Right, so let's lock the October date. That's decided.
